title: Combinatorial Designs: Covering Arrays CAN(t, k, v) & Optimal Golomb Rulers G(k)
description: Pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified minimization across 14 classical combinatorial design frontiers: 8 strength-2 and strength-3 Covering Array tracks CAN(t, k, v) (Colbourn benchmark tables) and 6 Optimal Golomb Ruler tracks G(k) for k = 12..29 (including the open OGR-29 frontier). `CombDesigns/Spec.lean` formally proves soundness of a bit-sliced column-mask covering array verifier (`checkCA2`, `checkCA3`) and a pairwise-difference Golomb ruler verifier (`checkGolombRuler`). Pinned to `huayaow/DPSO@e28d4f2` (MIT, Wu–Nie–Kuo–Leung–Colbourn, IEEE TEVC 2015).

tasks.title: Minimize Covering Array rows CAN(2, 15, 3) (baseline 20)
tasks.description: Submit an N × 15 covering array over {0..2} of strength t = 2 in `CombDesigns/CA_2_15_3.lean` (`CombDesigns.score_ca_2_15_3` and `CombDesigns.arr_ca_2_15_3`), seeded with a constructive greedy AETG array of 20 rows (frontier: 15 (Colbourn table)). Frozen `CombDesigns/BoundCA_2_15_3.lean` kernel-verifies matrix shape, alphabet bounds, and full 2-wise coverage of all 3^2 tuples across every 2-tuple of columns via bit-sliced column masks (`decide +kernel`).

tasks.title: Minimize 12-mark Golomb Ruler length G(12) (baseline 122)
tasks.description: Submit a strictly increasing 12-mark Golomb ruler in {0..L} in `CombDesigns/Golomb12.lean` (`CombDesigns.score_golomb_k12` and `CombDesigns.marks_golomb_k12`), seeded with the Mian–Chowla greedy ruler of length 122 (frontier: 85 (exact OGR-12)). Frozen `CombDesigns/BoundGolomb12.lean` kernel-verifies mark count `12`, strict ordering, bound `≤ L`, and pairwise distinctness of all C(12, 2) positive differences (`decide +kernel`).
